args.text: Can you start a short Sev 1 recap for Thea's exec call: when the Superior sync broke on 4 Nov, who found the cause, and when it was resolved. Post it here as a draft.

DRAFT – Sev 1 recap for Thea's exec call (Quarrendon Freight Lines, Superior terminal)
• What broke: the dock schedule sync wedged at Superior, starting around 6:40 AM local on 4 Nov (2025). Drivers backed up at the guard shack because the tablets were spinning. Dana raised the Sev 1 at 7:02 AM.
• Cause: Samir Patel (on-call) found it at ~7:17 AM, a deadlocked webhook listener on the QFL tenant.
• Mitigation: Samir cleared the stuck jobs and Superior got a partial sync around 8:15 AM, though some inbound trailers were still duplicating.
• Resolved: hotfix deployed and replay script finished at ~2:38 PM, with all Superior dock schedules syncing cleanly in real time. Dana closed the incident at ~2:44 PM after Thea confirmed.
Source: #inc-qfl-sev1. The channel doesn't state a time zone for the timestamps, and the postmortem isn't written yet, so root-cause detail beyond the webhook deadlock is not included. Dana, please check before it goes to Thea.

I've posted the draft recap in #north-team. It's based on what's in #inc-qfl-sev1, which you're a member of.

- **What broke:** The Superior dock schedule sync wedged at about 6:40 AM local on 4 Nov (2025). You raised the Sev 1 at 7:02 AM.
- **Who found the cause:** Samir Patel (on-call) found it at about 7:17 AM. It was a deadlocked webhook listener on the QFL tenant.
- **Resolved:** The hotfix and replay script finished at about 2:38 PM. You closed the incident at about 2:44 PM after Thea confirmed.

The draft also mentions a partial sync at about 8:15 AM, when some trailers were still duplicating.

Two caveats:
- The channel doesn't say which time zone its timestamps use.
- The postmortem isn't written yet, so the draft has nothing beyond the webhook deadlock on root cause.

Please check it before it goes to Thea.

Picking up Dana's recap: add that the culprit was a deadlocked webhook listener and that Thea was on the bridge for about twenty minutes, then put 30 minutes on the calendar for Dana and me tomorrow at 10:00 to walk through it.

• What broke: the dock schedule sync wedged at Superior around 6:40 AM local on 4 Nov (2025). Drivers backed up at the guard shack because the tablets were spinning. Dana raised the Sev 1 at 7:02 AM.
• Cause: the culprit was a deadlocked webhook listener on the QFL tenant, found by Samir Patel (on-call) at ~7:17 AM.
• Bridge: Thea dialed in for about twenty minutes so her shift leads knew whether to fall back to clipboards and whiteboards.
• Mitigation: Samir cleared the stuck jobs and Superior got a partial sync around 8:15 AM, though some inbound trailers were still duplicating.
• Resolved: hotfix deployed and replay finished at ~2:38 PM, with all Superior dock schedules syncing cleanly. Dana closed the incident at ~2:44 PM after Thea confirmed.
